description: Collapses this package's three ecosystem artefacts into a single pull request.
All three share one version tag, because Composer needs a semver-parseable tag at the
repository root and prefixed tags like `php/v1.2.0` are not an option. So a change touching only
the oxlint rules still bumps the version PHP and Python consumers see. Without this grouping a
polyglot repository gets three PRs for one upstream commit.
Included by the org-wide default preset; extend it directly only if you are not using that.

prBodyNotes: A major bump may reformat files or surface new findings. Run the formatters and analysers before merging:
- PHP: `composer run fmt` then `composer run analyze`
- JavaScript: `pnpm run fmt` then `pnpm run lint`
- Python: `matchory-coding-style sync` then `ruff check` and `ruff format`
If the diff is only formatting, commit it separately from the version bump so review stays readable.

description: The version line moves for reasons unrelated to your ecosystem, so a patch bump is often a
no-op for a given repository. Automerge those; anything else gets read by a human.
